name: guardian

biasScores.allsides: Left (-3.5), moved from Lean Left (-2.4) after Nov. 2024 editorial review
biasScores.mbfc: Left-Center to Left (editorial voice: self-described as 'centre-left' since 2004)

notes: AllSides' panel cited 'strong Left word choice bias, slant, story choice bias, sensationalism.' The Guardian itself has acknowledged a centre-left editorial identity.

name: aljazeera

biasScores.allsides: Lean Left (independent review Sept. 2019, reaffirmed June 2022)
biasScores.mbfc: Mixed factual reporting rating, citing 'misleading extreme editorial bias that favors Qatar'

notes: Al Jazeera is funded by the government of Qatar; AllSides and MBFC both flag this as relevant context distinct from left/right lean. AllSides found emotionalism, slant, and bias by omission of right-leaning perspectives.

name: npr

biasScores.allsides: Lean Left (-1.88 in May 2025 blind survey; moved from Center in Feb. 2022)

notes: Rating applies to NPR's online written content only (not radio). NPR's fact-check section and opinion content are separately rated Lean Left by AllSides.

name: dw
notes: Deutsche Welle is Germany's state-funded international broadcaster. Ground News' aggregate of AllSides+MBFC+Ad Fontes lands on Center; MBFC alone rates it Left-Center.

name: france24
politicalView: Center (slight left lean in story selection)
notes: France 24 is owned by French state holding company France Médias Monde. MBFC notes it has no op-ed page and 'story selection very slightly favors the left.' AllSides has not formally rated it (Not Rated).

name: cbc
notes: AllSides panelists agreed CBC's straight reporting is largely neutral/fact-based but found a Lean Left stance specifically on coverage of social issues, plus left-leaning word choice and bias by omission.

name: abc_au
notes: Australia's publicly-funded national broadcaster. MBFC: 'story selection that moderately favors the left,' while rating factual reporting High and noting it as a certified IFCN-style fact-checker.

name: euronews
notes: MBFC: 'well-sourced neutral news reporting and a moderate left lean in editorial content.' Also flags sponsored/paid content from foreign governments (Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Azerbaijan) as a factuality caveat unrelated to left/right lean.

name: sky

biasScores.allsides: Lean Left (low-confidence rating, differs from MBFC/Ad Fontes)

notes: Owned by Comcast/Sky UK. MBFC and Ad Fontes both place Sky News UK near dead-center with high reliability; AllSides' Lean Left rating is explicitly flagged by AllSides itself as low-confidence, so the stronger consensus (MBFC + Ad Fontes) is Center.

name: independent
notes: MBFC: 'story selection that moderately favors the left'; factual reporting rated Mixed due to several failed fact checks (high volume of published content is cited as a mitigating factor).

name: thehill

biasScores.allsides: Center (-0.66, April 2026 editorial review; -0.76 in May 2022 blind survey)

notes: AllSides briefly moved The Hill to Lean Left in a March 2026 review, then reverted to Center after a follow-up review the same month found 'mixed consensus.' Consistently close to the Center/Lean-Left border across years of surveys.

name: vox

biasScores.allsides: Left (Aug 2023 blind survey and Apr 2022 independent review both confirmed Left)

notes: One of the most consistently and strongly left-rated outlets in this list across all four raters. MBFC: 'editorial positions and story selection that routinely favors the left,' while still rating factual reporting High.

name: time

biasScores.allsides: Lean Left (moved from Left to Lean Left after Sept. 2018 editorial review; reconfirmed May 2023)
biasScores.mbfc: Left-Center (-4.0, near the Left/Left-Center boundary), High factual reporting

notes: AllSides noted TIME's news pieces are 'narrative-based' with frequent 'puff pieces favorable to Democrats,' though less sensationalist than outlets it rates as Left.

name: rt
politicalView: Right-leaning / Russian state propaganda outlet (bias framework applies imperfectly)

biasScores.allsides: Lean Right (initial team review; low confidence)
biasScores.mbfc: Right-Center bias score (4.70) but classified overall as 'Questionable' due to propaganda and very low factual reporting

notes: RT is wholly funded and controlled by the Russian government (registered as a 'foreign agent' by the US DOJ in 2017). All three raters flag it as a special case: AllSides notes RT's positioning reflects 'whatever ... best reflects the views of the current Russian government' rather than conventional US left/right politics, and MBFC's overriding classification is 'Questionable' (propaganda/conspiracy/fake news risk) rather than a standard left-right label.
